estimates.anchor_source: No market or consensus on SBC (Kalshi KXABNB nights ladder, Polymarket price ladders only, 2026-09-17T08:21:21Z; LSEG EPS is GAAP so SBC is inside it). Anchor = the repo's registered M7 below-EBITDA rule (vintage 2026-09-11): 4Q26 SBC $465M with its h=2 walk-forward error pool (MAE $25-31M, Gaussian sd ~$35M) -> P(>=500) ~0.16. Base rate: Q4/Q2 seasonal ratio on 2Q26 $487M (2023-25 mean 0.962; >= 1.027 in 1 of 4 years). Decomposition: y/y rule on the printed 4Q25 $411M blended with the seasonal route and the FY26 'lower than 2025' sentence route.
estimates.independence_note: the anchor is the same y/y rule at the error scale of a pool that includes the 2024 step regime; the seasonal and FY26-sentence routes are separate objects and land at 0.05-0.10

model.conventions: object = 'Stock-based compensation expense' in the 4Q26 release reconciliation (three months); 4Q25 printed $411M (registry's $400M is the driver-history error); threshold fixed at $500M

impact.note: SBC is below adjusted EBITDA: no margin effect. At $500M vs the team path's $465M (+$35M; FY27 run-rate +$140M vs M7's $2,053M) GAAP EPS (the Street basis) is -$0.05 in 4Q26 and -$0.20 in FY27; a full P/E mark would be -$5.4 at 26.9x, half-weighted to -$3 because SBC-driven misses are discounted by EBITDA/FCF holders. EV 0.10 x -3 = -$0.3/share: immaterial; drop from the memo.

sensitivity.assumption: Q4/Q2 regime = all four years incl. 2022 (0.979, sd 0.034)
y/y regime = last 8 quarters incl. the 2024 step (17.1 +/- 6.9)
a discrete Q4 grant event adds $30M

monitoring.action: large one-off grant or a stated headcount re-acceleration -> +0.03 to +0.10
